title: Supplementary distribution and transmission lines need scoped physical protection evidence
remediation: The facility engineering and network security owners identify assessed distribution and transmission lines on restricted drawings. Review controls over physical access at applicable rooms, enclosures and exposed access points. Verify a dated inspection and sampled owner approval or inherited facility assurance, and retain sanitized references in the package.

milestones.title: Collect the approved line inventory and restricted drawing references, a redacted inspection, and disposition of any access-control finding
